description: Medida de Adaptación al Cambio Climático. Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente - SDA. La implementación de la fase II y el mantenimiento y fortalecimiento de la fase I, de los proyectos de adaptación al cambio climático basada en ecosistemas (AbE) formulados para las localidades de Usme (rural) y San Cristóbal (urbano) y Capacitación Comunitaria e Implementación de una Iniciativa Ciudadana Socioambiental en la Localidad de Usme (urbano). Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente - SDA. Its tags are Ecohuerta, Pluviómetro, ambiente, cambio climatico. It offers 8 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, KMZ. The portal shows 2025-09-12 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
